BiblicalUsage: Issachar is named 40 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Genesis 30:18; Exodus 1:3; Numbers 1:8. In Genesis 30:18 we read, "And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband..." It appears again in Numbers 1:8: "Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar."
TheologicalSignificance: Issachar is brief in Scripture and long in God's memory, and that is my conviction. The Bible does not waste names, and neither does God.
